text:
Type: round compass rose kids rug
Use: playing on the floor; children's room, playroom
Style: contemporary, retro
Materials: short soft low pile, bound edge
Colors: black, white, bright yellow, green edge
Shape: circle printed as a compass dial with degree markings, letters and a yellow needle, thin green rim, flat, medium size
Feel: playful, adventurous, bold
Goes with: white walls, light wood, yellow or green accents, maps; explorer-themed kids' rooms and playrooms

product.name: UTFORSKA
product.description: The latex backing keeps the rug in place when the child runs,plays on it.
